description: List reviewed active repository metadata in UUID order. Pages reflect the live catalog.
name: repository.search

description: Read approved repository identity, policy, notice and active generation.
name: repository.info

description: List the approved ref snapshot of a readable generation in raw-byte order.
name: git.refs

description: Resolve the default, an exact ref or a full OID to an immutable context reusable by other tools.

name: git.resolve

name: git.ls_tree

name: git.find

description: Read a literal approved blob path. Byte ranges are zero-based and half-open. Use base64 for arbitrary byte slices.
name: git.read

description: Search approved blobs at a resolved commit. Lines are one-based and original byte ranges are zero-based and half-open. A partial empty page leaves results unknown.

name: git.rg

description: List approved commit metadata by graph distance and then native object ID. A literal path filters changes against the first parent.
name: git.log

description: Read approved commit metadata and changes against the first or selected parent. Root commits use the empty tree.
name: git.show

description: Compare two approved commits in one repository generation. Returns approved paths and bounded hunks or binary metadata.
name: git.diff

description: Attribute approved lines at one literal path along first parents. Line ranges are one-based and half-open. Coverage identifies unresolved lines.
name: git.blame
